def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if seen[r][c] or grid[r][c] == bg:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            seen[r][c] = True
            stack = [(r,c)]
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y,x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx = y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and not seen[yy][xx] and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen[yy][xx] = True
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            ys = [y for y,x in cells]
            xs = [x for y,x in cells]
            comps.append((color,cells,min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs)))
    panels = []
    for o in comps:
        color,cells,a,b,c,d = o
        if c-a == d-b and c-a >= 3 and len(cells) == (c-a+1)**2:
            panels.append(o)
    n = max(c-a+1 for color,cells,a,b,c,d in panels)
    panels = [o for o in panels if o[4]-o[2]+1 == n]
    panels.sort(key=lambda o:(o[2],o[3]))
    sources = [o for o in comps if o not in panels and o[4]-o[2]+1 == n-2 and o[5]-o[3]+1 == n-2]
    per_row = sum(1 for p in panels if p[2] == panels[0][2])
    out = [[0]*(per_row*n) for _ in range((len(panels)//per_row)*n)]
    for i,p in enumerate(panels):
        color = p[0]
        src = next(s for s in sources if s[0] == color)
        rr,cc = (i//per_row)*n,(i%per_row)*n
        for y in range(n):
            for x in range(n):
                out[rr+y][cc+x] = color
        _,_,a,b,c,d = src
        for y in range(a,c+1):
            for x in range(b,d+1):
                v = grid[y][x]
                out[rr+1+y-a][cc+1+x-b] = color if v == bg else v
    return out
